- Paste a B站视频 (Bilibili) link to get a direct, watermark-free video download link.
- Supports both single and batch video link parsing; summarizes success and failure for batches.
- Automatically checks if links are valid B站视频 URLs, and supports both www.bilibili.com and b23.tv formats.
